message_source.name: message_source
message_source.value: ("messages"."role" = 'user' and "messages"."source" is not null) or ("messages"."role" = 'assistant' and "messages"."source" is null and "messages"."origin_destination_id" is null)

preference_actor_task.name: preference_actor_task
preference_actor_task.value: ("preference_revisions"."actor" = 'task' and "preference_revisions"."task_id" is not null) or ("preference_revisions"."actor" <> 'task' and "preference_revisions"."task_id" is null)
